key_insight: VA-LSVI-UCB++ achieves variance-adaptive regret Õ(d√(H min{Var_K*, Var_K^π}) + d⁵H⁴), eliminating polynomial dependence on episode count K in deterministic environments.
engineering_relevance: For systems modeled as episodic time-inhomogeneous linear MDPs, the algorithm offers computationally efficient learning guarantees that improve when trajectory uncertainty is low.
method: Decompose optimistic, pessimistic, and squared value estimators simultaneously into reference and advantage terms.
Combine variance self-bounding with Freedman-type value-difference arguments.
Tighten pessimistic and second-moment confidence radii by an Õ(dH) factor.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical regret guarantees, including a minimax-optimal worst-case leading term Õ(d√(H³K)), but no empirical evaluation.
watch_item: The guarantee assumes a linear MDP model, and the additive Õ(d⁵H⁴) term may be substantial for large feature dimensions or horizons.
paper_title: Efficient Variance-Aware Reinforcement Learning in Time-Inhomogeneous Linear MDPs
